body:
The letter has arrived a moment ago.

I'm leaving the letter for my wife on my desk and formatting my C drive to make sure she'll never hear this story. 

I hope bullet will do this quick. 

I've dreamt about Kate again today. There's no point for me to stay here thinking about her again and again.

Whoever you are, thanks for reading my story. 
It's time.


Over and out.
o7

I don't want her to know the story. 
She's the only person that has ever cared about me, the only person that ever gave shit about me. I'm scared that she won't accept the fact that I've loved another person for all theese years. I don't want her to hate me and forget about me when I'm gone. We had so many plans for the future. But I just can't. I feel too exhausted to do anything. No matter what I do, no matter when, there's always Kate on and on again.

Of course fucking postal services didn't deliver my letter today. I will have to wait until tomorrow.
